game_title: Roll Call Enumerate – Moonlit Clearing Trial
game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Moonlit Clearing, a moonlit clearing: the druid must handle bramble beasts while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Roll Call Enumerate: Use enumerate to call out each position and name in a roll call.
theme: Mystic Forest – Moonlit Clearing: a moonlit clearing
core_gameplay_loop: In Moonlit Clearing, repeat each round: Use enumerate to call out each position and name in a roll call. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the roll_call value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the waterfall gate using at most 11 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The waterfall gate reached with actions_used <= 11.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 11 before the waterfall gate is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 2 (intro tier): Roll Call Enumerate
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
